answer: Farm keys score and vanish before anyone links the parent cluster. Each joiner mints one opal = blake2s(pubkey||nic_fingerprint||epoch)[:14] and walks it down a public vine of five kiosks picked by a block-height lottery that excludes the invite tree. At kiosk i they leave a pressed yarrow = hmac-sha256(opal||i||kiosk_pk||slot). Cost: 16 POA locked 5 epochs plus a 0.35 percent kiosk stipend. Peers rerun the lottery and recompute every yarrow against posted slots. A reused fingerprint, skipped kiosk, or kin winner cracks the token, slashes 28 percent to the reporter, and bars that nic 4 epochs.
